containers.name: prod
containers.description: Root of the prod HDFS environment.

containers.name: gold_safe
containers.description: Staging copy of cleansed output, immediately before Hive load.

containers.name: datalake_gold_safe
containers.description: Datalake job outputs, grouped by job name.

containers.name: loan_repayment_tracking_gold_safe
containers.description: Daily (T-3) loan repayment tracking summary, aggregated by product and loan_class, written directly here (tab-separated) by the loan_repayment pipeline's Loan Repayment Tracking Spark step -- before being copied to local disk, gzipped, and delivered to the dashboard. Files land under a daily YYYYMMDD subfolder.

columns.name: product
columns.description: Loan product code, taken from account_subtype_name on the loan account information input.

columns.name: loan_class
columns.description: 1-5, or Closed when loan_status is deactivate.

columns.name: number_of_accounts_current
columns.description: Count of accounts in this product/loan_class for the current calendar month.

columns.name: number_of_accounts_previous_month
columns.description: Count of accounts in this product/loan_class for the previous calendar month.

columns.name: average_acs_score_current
columns.description: Average current_credit_score for this product/loan_class in the current calendar month.

columns.name: average_ace_score_when_apply
columns.description: Average score at time of application for this product/loan_class. See draft notes: the source doc's execution-logic text calls this average_acs_score_when_apply (vs. average_ace_score_when_apply in its own output-schema table), and computes it from current_credit_score -- the same field used for average_acs_score_current -- which looks like it may be a doc error for credit_score.
